xBRIEFInfo.description: F3 - Batch disk writes in the fingerprint loop

plan.title: F3 - Batch disk writes in the fingerprint loop

narratives.Overview: The duplicate-detection fingerprint loop serialises its cache to disk after every single video.
narratives.Problem: DuplicateDetectionView.swift:362 calls caches[owner]!.save() inside the per-video loop -- a full JSON encode and flash write per item. A 500-video scan performs 500+ write cycles.
narratives.Action: Flush every 25-50 items, and on completion AND cancellation.
narratives.Risk: Batching introduces a data-loss window. A cancelled or failed scan must retain work up to the last flush -- this is the acceptance criterion that matters most.
